messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: realtime-streaming-service p99 latency > SLO threshold (8.2s). Alert group: streaming:latency. Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/3245678901 :rotating_light:

mike (oncall): ack. oncall here. jumping in. any owned deploys recently?

tara (sre): saw a small config push to edge-proxy rules ~10:02UTC, not sure if related. p95 ~1.1s -> p99 spiked to 8.2s at 10:15. clients report stalled SSE/chunks.

li (infra): confirming proxy cfg change 10:02 by automation (keepalive backoff tweak). reverting now to previous 10:17. I'll post status.

carla (runtime): logs show repeated "write timeout" from streamer -> proxy upstream. chunk flush intervals increased, KV cache hit rates steady. suspect downstream backpressure + proxy timeout.

ops-shift: impact: roughly 12 customers showing mid-session stalls, ~3% active connections experiencing >5s chunk gaps. No data loss, messages resume after reconnect for most.

mike (oncall): is there a quick mitigation we can flip? rollback incoming from li, ETA?

li (infra): rollback in progress, applying previous config to all edge nodes. 10:21 started, 10:24 done for 30% of fleet, 10:28 100%.
messages_continued:
tara (sre): after rollback p99 dropped to 3.9s but still above SLO. we have residual tail. looks like some clients are still queued in proxy queues.

carla (runtime): repro steps attached: connect -> start SSE stream -> send long response -> observe chunk gaps. sample traces:
```
trace_id=abcd1234 span=stream_write duration=8200ms status=DELAYED
proxy_write_timeout after 30s
```

mike (oncall): can we throttle large payloads or enable smaller chunk flushes?

carla (runtime): we can force flush every 128KB instead of 1MB to reduce tail. pushing a config toggle to runtime pool now. will need 30s to roll.

ops-shift: customer workaround: refresh stream if gap >10s. support ping note drafted.

li (infra): observability: proxy queue depth peaked at 9k, now 1.2k after rollback and runtime toggle. keepalive connections stable.

tara (sre): short-term plan: 1) rollback proxy change (done), 2) enable frequent chunk flush (in progress), 3) temporarily scale proxy workers by +20% (initiated). Medium: investigate client backpressure patterns and tuning.

mike (oncall): action owners: li for infra scaling/rollback, carla for runtime flush toggle, tara to monitor SLO trend and customer impact, mike to coordinate comms.

carla (runtime): runtime toggle rolled at 10:33. p99 now 1.6s. p95 back to 0.9s. noticing some clients still at 4-6s — likely replay/slow consumer clients.

ops-shift: internal impact note: 12 customers affected, 3 Tier-1 accounts saw degraded streaming for 6-12 minutes. no revenue-impacting errors reported yet. Support already contacted top 3.

tara (sre): logging additional traces for sessions with client RTT >200ms. tagging for post-incident analysis.

mike (oncall): ok good containment. let's keep monitoring 30m. if p99 stays <2s we can close incident. otherwise escalate to infra eng for deeper proxy tuning.

li (infra): monitoring dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/streaming/edge-proxy-queues. scaling rollback metrics look stable.

carla (runtime): note for postmortem: correlation between keepalive backoff tweak + a burst of long responses -> queue growth -> write timeouts. add regression test for chunk flush under proxy queue pressure.

ops-shift: drafting customer-facing blurb. I'll post to #customer-impact when ready.

mike (oncall): marking incident as: mitigated -> (controls applied, rollback + flush). assigning post-incident review to tara/carol/runtime team. leaving monitoring for 30m then will close. :white_check_mark:
